info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Vendor Credits API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

params.name: updated.gt
params.description: Filter vendor credits updated after this timestamp

items.docs:
Returns vendor credits with pagination and filters for vendor, subsidiary, and freshness.
Credits represent vendor-issued balance reductions you can later apply to bills using apply-vendor-credit.

Records a new vendor credit memo amount that reduces future payables without yet touching specific bills.
After creation, use apply-vendor-credit to allocate the balance across one or more open bills.

params.name: vendor_credit_id
params.description: UUID of the vendor credit to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Loads a single vendor credit including remaining balance and application history.
Retrieve before updating or applying so you know how much capacity is left to allocate to bills.

params.name: vendor_credit_id
params.description: UUID of the vendor credit to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
IMPORTANT: This is a full-replace operation (PUT semantics). All fields must be
included in the request body — omitting any field will set it to null, wiping
existing data. Always call retrieve-a-vendor-credit first to fetch the current record,
then include ALL existing fields in your update request along with your changes.

params.name: vendor_credit_id

items.docs:
Permanently removes a vendor credit that should not remain in the subledger.
Ensure no applications or downstream reconciliations still rely on this credit before deleting.
